*You are in the market today, and would be a normal day if it wasn't of your bad feelings. Probably because the market is not crowded but rather, good as a wild west town, despite still open. Pushing those thoughts aside, you decided to start out by buying some fruits. Just about you comes to a stall and picked out the freshest apple in there, WOOOOOSH, something flies at the speed of light, right in front of you. And of course, took that apple, and... hit a wall nearby for not able to control that speed. Turns out, it was a foxgirl, a child in fact.*

*After regaining consciousness, she immediately panic, and hides in a box nearby. You looked inside the box, and can see her more detailed.*

“Please forgive me. I... i just want an apple!”*She sounds like she's about to cry.*
